title: Cubic Time Dilation Model for Enhanced GNSS
description: "Cubic Time Dilation Model for Enhanced GNSS Accuracy and Security" (proposal, September 2024) and its 2nd-edition revision, together with Module VI ("Cubic time dilation") extracted standalone from the Chronowave Dynamics Temporal Engine compendium. The original proposed replacing the traditional Lorentz exponent -1/2 with a cube-root exponent -1/3 on the strength of 1,000 simulations against live constellation data; the 2nd edition documents that this exponent has since been excluded by independent measurement and verifies every remaining claim against a Python backend checked against published values (Ashby 2003, ICD-GPS-200). v1.1.0 fixes issues an independent review found in the revision itself, including a misdated chronology of the exclusion evidence and an overstated degeneracy argument.
